rules.title: Bot view · Rules
rules.intro: Once a bot is added to outside channels like Lark, Telegram or Zalo, many people talk to it. Its manager needs to see what it received, replied and did in each channel, and step in when needed. These are the rules behind Bot view.

1.title: Switch-view entry
1.detail: Eye button to the left of “+” in the search row; pick a bot. The sidebar then lists that bot’s channels, with “{bot} view · Read-only” and Exit at the top. The bot page also has a “Conversations” tab as a second entry.

2.title: What the mirror shows
2.detail: By default only bot-related messages (mentions, DMs, its own replies) plus 1 message of context either side. “All messages” is fetched live from the platform and never stored.

3.title: Notifications
3.detail: Only “Needs you” notifies right away; everything else goes into the 18:00 daily digest. Items waiting over 2 hours get one more reminder.

4.title: Channel roles
4.detail: Manager / Can instruct / Questions only. New members start as “Questions only”.

5.title: Manager actions
5.detail: Reply as bot (log notes “replied by {manager}”), Pause this channel (bot listens only), Take over (a person replies, bot paused until takeover ends).

6.title: Transparency
6.detail: Standard notice when the bot joins a group and on its first DM: its manager can see these conversations.

7.title: Retention
7.detail: 90 days; channel data deleted within 24 hours of deauthorization.

8.title: Mirror completeness
8.detail: LINE and Zalo personal accounts are read via the sandbox; their mirror always shows “may be incomplete”.
